R6I-grouse-walk-0001.name: 1.0 km SE of Goldeneye Lake rec site
R6I-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: 3.5 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).
R6I-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Hudson Bay Mountain Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Trail: Bulkley Valley Nordic Center trail, 3.2 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
6 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 122 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beam Station Rd, Queensway Dr, Hwy 16, Hwy 16 and 37.
Park: 54.72662, -127.20931, pull off on Hudson Bay Mountain Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 250 m to the start. Walk: the Bulkley Valley Nordic Center trail stretch, 3.2 km one way. About 64 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-9, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R6I-grouse-walk-0001.recDirections: Turn left at lights from Hwy 16 on to Tatlow Road in Smithers, turn right onto Pacific Street, turn Left on Dahlie Road, cross over railway overpass. Follow the hard left turn on to Hudson Bay Mountain Road (follow skier signs), continue up Hudson Bay Mountain Road, through switchbacks and BV Nordic Centre is first right after switchbacks, at 9km.
R6I-grouse-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-9: about 10,278 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.72 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
